limitations: All names, rosters, equipment, times, qualifications beyond source examples, rules and training history are invented; no operational records were retrieved.
FICTIONAL-PB4T-1 fatigue and recurrence values are unapproved demonstration assumptions, not Navy or SFTRM rules. Owner-approved values and domain review are still required.
The fictional fixed-window recurrence grammar is not an official SFTRM format; no completion credit carries between windows.
First-feasible deterministic search does not establish global optimality; exhaustion is not infeasibility.
Expected outcomes were hand-keyed using interval arithmetic, not application code or toolkit solver results. This intake validates data consistency only, not an application.
Persistence, final API/status vocabulary, user interface and operational approval remain downstream responsibilities; no deployment, delivery or operational approval occurs in this session.
